title: Fix document-root escape (string-prefix containment) and NUL bytes in a static file path resolver

hidden_checks.spec: Finding 1 + rule 3: /srv/www-private and /srv/wwwx are not below /srv/www (segment-wise comparison).
Finding 2 + rule 5: a decoded path containing NUL raises PathTraversalError.
Desired behavior: PathTraversalError is the existing subclass of ValueError.
Rule 3: anything not root or below it raises PathTraversalError (rule 1: %2E%2E decodes to ..).
Rule 3: .. segments are fine as long as the resolved result stays inside (/docs/../index.html).
Rule 3: the result may be root itself; rule 6: root returned normalized; rule 2 leading slashes ignored.
Rule 2: only . and .. segments are special; other names are ordinary.
Rule 1: percent-escapes decoded as urllib.parse.unquote does (%20 -> space); rule 2 then interprets slashes.
Rule 1: decoded exactly once; %252e becomes the literal %2e, an ordinary name.
Rule 2: leading slashes ignored, repeated slashes collapse, . resolved; rule 6 normalized.
Rule 6: no trailing slash in the returned path.
Rule 4: root may be /, in which case every request resolves inside it; rule 6 returns / for the root.
Rule 5: NUL bytes are rejected regardless of root.
Rule 3: segment-wise containment for any root.
Rule 2: never consults the filesystem; a symlink inside the root is returned as the path inside the root.
